reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Clippers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 71 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Memphis have won six of seven and are 9-1 on the road, but are now without Cameron Boozer (ankle, at least a month) and Jerami Grant (calf, at least two weeks); Ty Jerome is back and scored 29 on Monday. The Clippers have lost four straight and Brandon Ingram is still on a minutes limit after his debut. Memphis's confidence outweighs their injuries, so the angle leans Memphis.
